title: Fast Gradient-Based Approximation of Continuous Dynamic Time Warping
abstract: arXiv:2610.13129v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) is a common choice for measuring the discrepancy between time series. It proceeds by finding an optimal warping between timestamps through dynamic programming, which can be slow and is not differentiable. Consequently, several variants have been proposed. Among them, Soft-DTW proposes a smooth formulation of DTW, amenable to gradient computation, while Continuous-DTW (CDTW) introduces a continuous formulation through parametrizable warping functions. Yet, computational costs remain high for both methods and impractical for large datasets in modern machine learning pipelines. This paper revisits CDTW in several ways. translated_title: 连续动态时间规整的快速梯度近似
translated_abstract: 动态时间规整（DTW）是度量时间序列之间差异的常用方法。它通过动态规划在时间戳之间寻找最优规整路径，但这一过程速度较慢且不可微分。因此，已有多种变体被提出。其中，Soft-DTW 提出了 DTW 的平滑形式，使其能够进行梯度计算；而连续动态时间规整（CDTW）则通过可参数化的规整函数引入了连续形式。然而，这两种方法的计算成本都很高，对于现代机器学习流水线中的大规模数据集而言并不实用。本文从多个方面重新审视了 CDTW。在证明了其在温和条件下的可微性之后，我们提出了 FastCDTW——一个高效的近似求解器，具有两种不同的计算策略：针对分段线性规整函数的精确闭式方案，以及针对平滑规整函数的无偏蒙特卡洛估计器……
tldr: 本文提出了 FastCDTW，一种高效的连续动态时间规整（CDTW）近似求解器，证明了其在温和条件下的可微性，并针对分段线性规整函数提供精确闭式解、针对平滑规整函数提供无偏蒙特卡洛估计两种计算策略，大幅降低了计算成本。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces FastCDTW, an efficient approximate solver for Continuous Dynamic Time Warping (CDTW) that establishes its differentiability under mild conditions and provides two computational strategies: an exact closed-form scheme for piecewise-linear warping functions and an unbiased Monte Carlo estimator for smooth ones, significantly reducing computational costs.
